thread:
megan (PM): Hey team — posting the draft PRD for the "Security & Compliance" section. Need signoff on acceptance criteria for audit logs, KMS/HSM, data retention, and SOC2 gaps. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.org/prd/INFER-5179

raj (sec-eng): Got it. Quick ask — do we treat Hosted + Dedicated + Private the same here or prioritize?

megan (PM): Prioritize Private + Dedicated first (enterprises). Hosted can be GA later, but we need clear roadmap items and launch criteria.

oliver (infra): +1 to prioritizing Dedicated/Private for BYOK/HSM. Hosted needs extra ops controls.

raj (sec-eng): Drafting acceptance criteria, keeping them testable. Initial set below, then we can iterate.

raj (sec-eng): Audit logs - acceptance criteria:
- All control-plane actions are logged with user, timestamp, IP, request-id.
- Logs are append-only and stored in an immutable store (S3 Object Lock or equivalent) for configurable retention.
- Logs are searchable/exportable as CSV/JSON and accessible via RBAC (security/audit role).
- Tamper-evidence: logs signed (HMAC) every 24h and retain checksum chain for retention period.
- Retention defaults: 13 months for SOC2 customers, configurable per-customer.

megan (PM): That looks good. Need specifics on how we demonstrate "append-only" and tamper-evidence for audits.

raj (sec-eng): Testable acceptance criteria additions:
- Automated test that writes a known audit event and verifies checksum record in archival store.
- Admin API to request immutable export for a time range; export includes signed manifest.

kevin (eng): For implementation: we can use S3 Object Lock + KMS CMKs for log encryption. Will require cross-account roles for Dedicated/private.

raj (sec-eng): KMS/HSM - acceptance criteria:
- Support customer-provided keys (BYOK) for Dedicated and Private (import or external KMS).
- All customer data & audit logs encrypted with KMS; keys are never persisted in plaintext on hosts.
- Key usage auditable: every decrypt/encrypt operation logged with key-id and request-id.
- Support hardware-backed keys (HSM) for customers that require FIPS-compliant key material.
- Key rotation: support scheduled rotation without downtime and ability to roll back within a timebox.

oliver (infra): Implementation notes: BYOK for Private is straightforward (customer's KMS inside VPC). For Dedicated we'll support KMS policies + cross-account key grants. Hosted BYOK will come in next phase.

diana (prod-designer): From docs standpoint we need a simple matrix in PRD: which features available per deployment (Hosted / Dedicated / Private).

megan (PM): Yes — include a matrix and launch gating per deployment.

sara (legal): On data retention and deletion: we need a documented legal-hold flow. If a customer requests deletion but we have a pending legal hold, we must surface that and not delete. Also need proof-of-deletion for customers when deletion completes.

raj (sec-eng): Data retention - acceptance criteria:
- Platform supports per-customer retention policy (days) with a minimum/maximum enforced by policy.
- Deletion pipeline that securely erases drafts, KV caches, and persistent logs according to retention and legal holds.
- Provide customers with a deletion certificate (signed manifest) with timestamps and deleted object IDs.
- Support region-scoped retention (EU customers can keep logs in EU regions only).

kevin (eng): Edge cases to call out in PRD:
- Legal hold overrides retention; API must return hold status and cannot delete during hold.
- Immediate purge requests must require elevated approval + 2FA & audit trail.
- Partial deletes (e.g., delete embeddings but keep prompt logs) — need clear scoping.

megan (PM): Good. Can someone propose exact launch criteria for GA (Private/Dedicated) and Beta (Hosted BYOK)?

raj (sec-eng): Suggested launch criteria (Private/Dedicated GA):
- All acceptance criteria above implemented and covered by automated tests.
- Security review completed with <3 medium/low open findings and mitigation plan for any high findings.
- SOC2 readiness: gaps identified and either closed or included in customer-facing BAU plan.
- Ops runbook + incident playbook for key compromises (key-exposure, log tamper) documented and rehearsed.
- Customer beta: at least 2 paying customers validated in staging with BYOK + retention workflows.

oliver (infra): Also need performance SLO verification: key rotation must not increase 95th-token-latency by >5% in Dedicated.

diana (prod-designer): Docs + UX: we need clear UI for key management, retention config, and legal-hold status. Mockups for admin console required before beta.

kevin (eng): Acceptance test examples we can automate:
1) Create BYOK key, configure workspace, run inference, assert logs show key-id and op.
2) Rotate key, run inference, assert older encrypted objects rekeyed or served via key-wrapping logic.
3) Request export, verify signed manifest and checksums.
4) Trigger legal hold API, attempt delete, expect 409 + hold reason.

raj (sec-eng): Edge cases / open questions for PRD team to resolve:
- Do we allow customer-supplied HSM connectors for Hosted? (ops cost heavy)
- Minimum retention policy defaults and allowed ranges per tier.
- Export formats & retention-proof canonical format for auditors.

megan (PM): Let's capture these as TODOs in PRD and assign owners. I'll update the doc.

sara (legal): One more: we need DSAR (data subject access request) flow in PRD: how customers request copies of their data, time to fulfill (30 days?), and proof of identity.

raj (sec-eng): Adding that: DSAR acceptance criteria:
- Admin API to produce per-customer data bundle (logs, artifacts, the active model prompts) within SLA (default 30d).
- Bundle is delivered encrypted to customer-specified endpoint or S3 with expiring link.

megan (PM): Great. I'll revise the PRD with the acceptance criteria + beta/ga gating and the matrix. Owners: raj -> security implementation, oliver -> infra changes, kevin -> automated tests, diana -> admin UX, sara -> legal flows.

deploy-bot: megan updated PRD: https://redwood.atlassian.org/prd/INFER-5179 (edited) :white_check_mark:

megan (PM): Thanks everyone — next sync Thurs 10:00 to review the updated PRD and queue any outstanding scope negotiation for Hosted. If anyone spots missing edge-cases, drop them here before EOD Wednesday. :sparkles:

raj (sec-eng): Will do, adding a short RFC with HSM options + threat model.

oliver (infra): I'll draft the infra plan for cross-account KMS and S3 Object Lock patterns.

kevin (eng): I'll stub the e2e tests into the repo and link in PRD.

sara (legal): I'll add the DSAR template and retention policy wording.

megan (PM): Perfect. Closing the thread for now.
